title: Explain liability, commitment, and contingency disclosures and analyses using liquidity ratios

items.concept: Settlement JE of prior contingency; warranty rollforward schedule; period-end adjusting JEs for warranty and litigation (emphasis); commitment disclosure (no JE); current and quick ratios before/after year-end accruals
Number-variant twin—settlement JE; warranty rollforward; period-end warranty and litigation AJs; commitment disclosures; current/quick ratios before and after accruals

Period-end adjusting JE emphasis—classify accrue/disclose/neither; record required AJs only; current and quick ratios; SEC 5% current liability component test; commitments and contingencies note outline
Quick (acid-test) ratio includes only the most liquid current assets
Commitments for future obligations are disclosed, not recorded as present liabilities
